sn9.3:1.1: Kassapagotta appears also in [an3.91](), where he initially resents the training before repenting.
sn9.3:1.2: _Cheta_ is unique. *Digital Pali Dictionary* explains it as an agent noun from _chandati_, equivalent to Sanskrit _chettṛ_ in the sense “woodcutter”; but why would a woodcutter be (a) stupid and (b) wandering in the hills?Commentary says he was a deer hunter.
